chunks: That is so for God is the undeniable truth, and what they invoke apart from Him is false; yet God is all-high and supreme.
ai.seo_question: Why is God considered the Truth and other gods false according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to establish the ontological supremacy of Allah as 'Al-Haqq' (The Ultimate Truth) against the contingent nature of idols, reinforcing the principle of Tawhid al-Dhat. The attributes 'Al-Ali' (The Most High) and 'Al-Kabir' (The Magnificent) emphasize His transcendence above all created limitations, a key theme in the concept of Divine Unity. This affirmation serves as the theological basis for rejecting all forms of shirk (polytheism) and idolatry.
